project: Director Neurolink Migration — AI Pipeline in TypeScript
description: Migrate the Director video pipeline's AI scoring, analysis, and optimization components from Python (video-production/library/) to a TypeScript layer at src/ using @juspay/neurolink. Mirrors dopamine's agent-based architecture with Zod schemas, structured output, rate limiting, policy enforcement, and observability. The Python pipeline (voiceover generation, avatar, B-roll, compositing, captions) remains unchanged — this migration targets the AI judgment layer: video scoring, script scoring, acoustic analysis, scene analysis, video comparison, and creative direction.

userStories.description: Create src/pipeline/state.ts that manages pipeline execution state as JSON files on disk. Enables resuming a pipeline run after a crash or interruption without re-running completed phases. Each phase writes its result to a state file; on resume, completed phases are skipped.

userStories.notes: The Python pipeline uses sequential phases with some concurrency. If a Gemini call fails at phase 4 (video-score), we should not re-run phases 1-3 (script-score, creative-prompts, acoustic-analysis) on resume. JSON state is simple and debuggable.

userStories.title: Create PolicyCreator for quality policy definitions
userStories.description: Create src/policy/creator.ts that defines quality policies for each agent output. Policies are declarative rules that specify minimum thresholds, required fields, and constraint validators. Follows dopamine's policy pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: src/policy/creator.ts exists
Exports Policy interface: { name, agentId, rules: PolicyRule[] }
PolicyRule types: 'min_score' (field path + threshold), 'required_field' (field path), 'range' (field path + min/max), 'custom' (predicate function)
Exports createVideoScorePolicy(): Policy — requires overall >= 7.0, each dimension >= 5.0, at least 3 improvements listed, at least 1 positive
Exports createScriptScorePolicy(): Policy — requires composite >= 7.0, hookStrength >= 7.0, ctaStrength >= 7.0

Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Policies define quality gates. A video score below 7.0 overall triggers re-iteration. Deal-breakers in video score trigger immediate halt. The thresholds (7.0 overall, 5.0 per-dimension) are based on the production target of 9.0+ from gemini_video_scorer.py — 7.0 is the 'not embarrassing' floor.
